name: Kilowatt-Hour & Operating Hour Meter
description: Electromechanical or digital active energy meter (kWh) and cumulative runtime hour meter (h) on industrial Service Entrance Panels.
sample_reference: 3_Digital Meters/2_Energy Meter_Operating Hour Meter & 1_Service Entrance Panel
indicator_type: Mechanical roller drums or segmented LCD display
prompt:
You are inspecting an ENERGY (kWh) OR OPERATING RUNTIME (Hour) METER.
DIGIT READOUT PROTOCOL:
1. METER TYPE DISCRIMINATION:
   - Energy Meter: Unit is 'kWh' or 'MWh'.
   - Operating Hour Meter: Unit is 'h' (hours) or 'hrs'.
2. READ SEQUENTIAL DIGITS:
   - Read digits from left to right.
   - Rightmost digit (often red-bordered or after a decimal comma) represents 1/10th (0.1 kWh or 0.1 h).
3. OUTPUT FORMAT (RAW JSON ONLY):
{
  "gauges": [{
    "gauge_index": 1,
    "gauge_type": "<energy_meter|hour_meter>",
    "bbox": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax],
    "reading": {"value": <float>, "unit": "<kWh|h>", "confidence": 0.95},
    "display_text": "<digit string>"
  }]
}
